test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Neither the teacher nor the students was present.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence consists of two elements joined by "**neither...nor**."
 
• When subjects are connected by "**neither...nor**," the verb agrees with the subject closer to it.
 
• In this case, the subject closer to the verb is "**the students**," which is plural.
 
• The verb "**was**" is singular and should instead be "**were**" to match the plural subject.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Neither the teacher nor the students were present."*
